items.title: Linux Kernel Process Accounting, (Wed, Aug 12th)
items.content: <article>A couple of days ago, Xavier posted about Atuin to gain more insight into the command history. Atuin does a great job of better organizing what is usually handled by "bash_history" and collecting meaningful additional data. Our reader David commented that this can also be done quite well with Linux's kernel process accounting feature, and I think he is very right. I really like Linux process accounting for a number of reasons, so here is a quick introduction.</article>

Microsoft Patch Tuesday August 2026, (Tue, Aug 11th)
items.content: <article>This month we got patches for 418 vulnerabilities. Of these, 62 are critical, 1 is being exploited in the wild, and 2 were publicly disclosed as zero-days. Notable fixes include Windows privilege escalation, container tampering, and critical QUIC and DNS Server remote code execution bugs. </article>

Scans for Solana (Surfpool?) Endpoints, (Mon, Aug 10th)
items.content: <article>Solana is a crypto platform known for speed. Developers like it to develop distributed applications or to implement crypto payments. To interact with the blockchain, APIs are provided for developers. These APIs will either "speak" JSON or gRPC. One implementation often used for development is "surfpool," which is used to test programs before deploying them to a Solana network.</article>
